mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the contamination of water bodies such as lakes, rivers, oceans, and groundwater caused by human activities, which can be harmful to organisms and plants which live in these water bodies."

Water pollution is the contamination of water bodies such as lakes, rivers, oceans, and groundwater caused by human activities, which can be harmful to organisms and plants which live in these water bodies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to relate water level to an associated streamflow."
The stage-streamflow relation is used to relate water level to an associated streamflow.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a function of water supply."
The growth of crops is a function of water supply.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the horizontal subsurface movement of water on continents."
Throughflow is the horizontal subsurface movement of water on continents.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the water leaving an area of drainage and flowing across the land surface to points of lower elevation."
Runoff specifically refers to the water leaving an area of drainage and flowing across the land surface to points of lower elevation.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important natural resource which provides us with the water we drink and wash with, and which is widely used in industry and for leisure activities."
Rainfall is an important natural resource which provides us with the water we drink and wash with, and which is widely used in industry and for leisure activities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for a variety of purposes, and these have very different quantity, quality, and timing characteristics."
Water is used for a variety of purposes, and these have very different quantity, quality, and timing characteristics.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the zone in the ground that is permanently saturated with water."
Groundwater is the zone in the ground that is permanently saturated with water.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the movement of water from precipitation into the soil layer."
Infiltration is the movement of water from precipitation into the soil layer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the two processes that move water from the Earth's surface to its atmosphere."
Evaporation and transpiration are the two processes that move water from the Earth's surface to its atmosphere.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the surface flow of water to areas of lower elevation."
Runoff is the surface flow of water to areas of lower elevation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same thing as a lake in many peoples' minds."
A reservoir is the same thing as a lake in many peoples' minds.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known as the water table."
The top of groundwater is known as the water table.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is that which occupies opening in the soil or rock."
Subsurface water is that which occupies opening in the soil or rock.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the system form that makes use of the variables in water cycle for its explanations, in order to lead you through a clearly defined pathway of the water cycle system, and the way each is evaluated."

The approach is the system form that makes use of the variables in water cycle for its explanations, in order to lead you through a clearly defined pathway of the water cycle system, and the way each is evaluated.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to two types of evapotranspiration: Actual Evapotranspiration and Potential Evapotranspiration."
Agricultural scientists sometimes refer to two types of evapotranspiration: Actual Evapotranspiration and Potential Evapotranspiration.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as any aqueous deposit, in liquid or solid form, that develops in a saturated atmospheric environment and generally falls from clouds."
Precipitation can be defined as any aqueous deposit, in liquid or solid form, that develops in a saturated atmospheric environment and generally falls from clouds.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the science that studies the Earth's water molecules and their movement through the hydrologic cycle."
Hydrology is the science that studies the Earth's water molecules and their movement through the hydrologic cycle.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a further refinement of the concept; for an IUH, the input rainfall is assumed to all take place at a discrete point in time (obviously, this is not the case for actual rainstorms)."

An instantaneous unit hydrograph is a further refinement of the concept; for an IUH, the input rainfall is assumed to all take place at a discrete point in time (obviously, this is not the case for actual rainstorms).

parallel drainage system

______ is a specific type of advection fog.
Evaporation fog
Evaporation fog is a specific type of advection fog.
______ is the term that is used to describe the process of water flowing in the organized channels of a stream or river.
Streamflow
Streamflow is the term that is used to describe the process of water flowing in the organized channels of a stream or river.
______ are the most valuable clues of all.
Rocks
Rocks are the most valuable clues of all.
______ are the ones that didn't run into as many droplets.
smaller drops
The smaller drops are the ones that didn't run into as many droplets.
______ is the continuous assessment component of your course.
TMA
The TMA is the continuous assessment component of your course.
______ is a type of precipitation common to the mid and high latitudes.
Snow
Snow is a type of precipitation common to the mid and high latitudes.
______ is a type of fog that is associated with weather fronts, particularly warm fronts.
Frontal fog
Frontal fog is a type of fog that is associated with weather fronts, particularly warm fronts.
______ is the molecular force of elements and compounds found on the surface of soil minerals.
strongest force
The strongest force is the molecular force of elements and compounds found on the surface of soil minerals.
______ is used to model the storage and movement of water molecules between the biosphere, atmosphere, lithosphere and hydrosphere.
hydrologic cycle
The hydrologic cycle is used to model the storage and movement of water molecules between the biosphere, atmosphere, lithosphere and hydrosphere.
______ refers to the process by which some portions of the rains are obstructed from reaching the earth surface.
Interception
Interception refers to the process by which some portions of the rains are obstructed from reaching the earth surface.
______ is the primary process of water transfer in the hydrological cycle.
Evaporation
Evaporation is the primary process of water transfer in the hydrological cycle.
______ are the hour, the day, the month and the year.
standard periods
The standard periods are the hour, the day, the month and the year.
______ is made up of water in the air (water vapour).
cloud
A cloud is made up of water in the air (water vapour).
______ is made up of water vapour and clouds.
atmospheric water
The atmospheric water is made up of water vapour and clouds.
______ is the area of land where all of the water that falls in it and drains off of it goes into the same place.
drainage basin
A drainage basin is the area of land where all of the water that falls in it and drains off of it goes into the same place.
______ is the process of water loss from plants through stomata.
Transpiration
Transpiration is the process of water loss from plants through stomata.
______ is responsible for capillary action, which allows water (and its dissolved substances) to move through the roots of plants and through the tiny blood vessels in our bodies.
Surface tension
Surface tension is responsible for capillary action, which allows water (and its dissolved substances) to move through the roots of plants and through the tiny blood vessels in our bodies.
______ is the fertilisation of surface water by nutrients that were previously scarce.
Eutrophication
Eutrophication is the fertilisation of surface water by nutrients that were previously scarce.
